examples: They sent aid to the town.
I called for aid.
The aid arrived fast.

more.def: Help that is given to people who need it.
examples: Food and blankets were sent as aid after the flood.
She called for aid when she fell.
The nurse gave first aid.
The nurse aids the doctor.
He aided the injured man.
Maps aid travelers.

more.def: To give help to someone or something.
examples: The nurse aided the doctor.
A map can aid hikers on a long trail.
Neighbors aided the family after the storm.

easy.def: To point something at a target.
examples: I aim at the target.
She aimed the ball at the hoop.
He aimed the arrow.

more.def: To point something at the place you want it to go.
examples: She aimed the ball at the basket and shot.
He aimed the hose at the flowers.
The archer aimed at the target.

easy.def: A goal that you are trying to reach.
examples: My aim is to finish.
His aim is to win.
Her aim is to read ten books.

more.def: The thing you are trying to do or reach.
examples: My aim is to learn to swim this summer.
The aim of the club is to clean up the park.
Her aim was to get an A in math.

easy.def: The invisible stuff around us that we breathe.
examples: We need air to live.
The air is cold today.
Fill the ball with air.

more.def: The mixture of gases around the Earth that people and animals breathe.
examples: Plants help clean the air we breathe.
The air on top of the mountain is cold and thin.
A bike tire needs air to roll smoothly.

related.def: Full of fresh air; open and light.

easy.def: A place where planes take off and land.
examples: We went to the airport.
The airport is big.
Planes land at the airport.

more.def: A place where planes take off and land, with buildings for passengers.
examples: We waited at the airport for our plane.
The airport is busy during the holidays.
Planes line up at the airport to take off.
